title: 第23章 拨云有日前行便是第24章 天生神力
slug: 从衔尾蛇石碑开始超凡
lines: 看着魄鲸拳后的经验值，林野目光平静。
一个下午的苦练只增长了2点经验值，并不多。
但其实已经很好了，这是看得见的进步。
不过是枯燥的苦练而已，他不缺耐心，也耐得住寂寞。
回到电脑桌前坐下，仰躺在座椅上看着天花板，指尖轻轻敲击着桌面。
‘这样算的话，差不多需要两个月才能练成第二层了。’
这还是建立在他有丰碑一证永证的基础上，如果没有丰碑的话，估计至少半年以上。
至于资质一般的人，恐怕需要两年甚至是三五年起步了。
而这只是从第一层迈向第二层，第二层到第三层需要的时间只会更长。
怪不得之前听一些老学员说第三层是个坎。
照这个难度，一般学员就算是日日勤修，等到有资格冲击第三层的时候，少说也快三十岁了。
如果没有这个毅力一天天坚持下来的话，基本上就是板上钉钉的三十岁之后。
但那个时候身体已经开始走下坡路，再想破关第三层，几乎是不可能了。
他摇摇头，“难，武道难啊。”
如果没有丰碑的话，或许他也会倒在第三层门槛前吧。
放松身体，几分钟后他坐起身，默默拿过魔药材料开始调配。
没多久，五瓶装着暗红粘稠液体的玻璃瓶放置在电脑桌上。
没再过多关注，眼下时间还早，他拿过一旁的《莱茵文解》翻看。
这个和《初级魔药学手札》不一样，不用耗费太多精神。
再抬起头时，已经到了深夜，看了一眼闹钟，23:47。
揉了揉脸，起身到卫生间洗了把脸，清醒了许多。
回到卧室，拉开窗帘，皓白月光照进来，把桌面上的灰尘都照成碎钻。
将五个装着暗红液体的玻璃瓶放到窗边静置，时间一分一秒流逝。
“滴滴——滴滴——”
闹铃的计时响了起来，随后被林野按下。
凌晨了。
看向五瓶魔药，几乎是同时，玻璃瓶壁上泛起银辉月华。
而后是熟悉的变化，银辉像是一条条扭动的银色线虫钻进药液里。
暗红粘稠液体迅速变得澄清，出现一粒粒黑红色颗粒物。
但很快，其中两瓶内部的银辉陡然消散。
漂浮的黑红颗粒物也在下一刻粉碎，沉积到玻璃瓶底部，成了棉絮一样的沉淀物。
林野微微点头，五瓶成功了三瓶，成功率60%，已经很不错了。
拿起一瓶失败的魔药观察，底部的棉絮物质逐渐变成淤泥一样的东西。
‘这东西喝了会有什么反应？’
content_en:
Looking at the experience value after the Soul Whale Fist, Lin Ye's eyes were calm.
An afternoon of hard training only gained 2 experience points, which is not much.
But it’s actually pretty good. This is visible progress.
It was just boring hard training. He was not lacking in patience and could endure loneliness.
Go back to the computer desk and sit down, lie back on the seat and look at the ceiling, tapping your fingertips lightly on the table.
‘If you calculate it this way, it will take almost two months to reach the second level. ’
This is still based on the fact that he has a monument and a permanent certificate. If he does not have a monument, it is estimated that it will take at least half a year.
As for people with average qualifications, it may take two years or even three to five years to start.
And this is just a step from the first level to the second level. The time required from the second level to the third level will only be longer.
No wonder I heard some veteran students say that the third level is a hurdle.
At this level of difficulty, even if the average student practices diligently every day, by the time they are qualified to hit the third level, they will be almost thirty years old at least.
If you don’t have this perseverance and persevere every day, it’s basically a certainty that you’ll be in your thirties.
But by that time, my body had begun to decline, and it was almost impossible to break through the third level.
He shook his head, "It's difficult, martial arts is difficult."
If there was no monument, maybe he would have collapsed in front of the threshold of the third floor.
Relaxing his body, he sat up after a few minutes, silently took the potion ingredients and began to mix them.
Not long after, five glass bottles filled with dark red viscous liquid were placed on the computer desk.
Without paying too much attention, it was still early, so he took the "Rhineland Literature Interpretation" beside him and flipped through it.
This is different from the "Elementary Potion Master's Manual", it doesn't require much effort.
When I raised my head again, it was already late at night, and I glanced at the alarm clock, which read 23:47.
I rubbed my face, got up and went to the bathroom to wash my face, feeling much more awake.
Back in the bedroom, I opened the curtains and the bright moonlight came in, turning the dust on the table into tiny diamonds.
Put five glass bottles filled with dark red liquid next to the window and let them stand. Time passed by.
"Didi-didi-"
The alarm timer rang, and then Lin Ye pressed it.
It's early morning.
Looking at the five bottles of magic potion, almost at the same time, silvery moonlight appeared on the walls of the glass bottles.
Then came a familiar change, Yinhui was like a twisting silver worm burrowing into the liquid.
The dark red viscous liquid quickly became clear, and black and red particles appeared.
But soon, the silver glow inside two of the bottles suddenly dissipated.
The floating black and red particles also shattered in the next moment and settled at the bottom of the glass bottle, forming a cotton-like sediment.
Lin Ye nodded slightly, and three of the five bottles were successful, with a success rate of 60%, which is already very good.
Picking up a bottle of failed potion and observing, the cotton-wool material at the bottom gradually turned into something like sludge.
‘What will happen if you drink this? ’
title_en: Chapter 23: Clear the clouds and move forward one day. Chapter 24: Innate Divine Power
